course_name: 進階逐步與同步口譯專業實務
outline:
本課程旨在訓練學生中英逐步口譯及會議同步口譯技巧，透過完整專業訓練及密集實務演練，學生所學將可運用於實際企業內口譯、隨行口譯及國際會議口譯。第一階段透過密集演練進階視譯、逐步口譯筆記、記憶分析，學生深化英文理解與口譯之表達能力，學習口譯中傳意不傳詞之精髓。第二階段進入同步口譯教程，學生將認識會議同步口譯之多重任務特質，並將斷句、倒譯、增補、糾正與歸納等同步技巧，運用於實際會議演說之口譯。

NOTE: This advanced course is unsuitable for those who have not already taken basic interpreting courses including sight translation and consecutive interpreting. Such individuals should try the "Interpretation Theory and Practice" course next year.

WEEK	SESSION THEME
1	Introduction
2     	Sight Translation (ST) (E-C/C-E)
3     	Paraphrasing and ST (C-E)
4     	Consecutive Interpretation (CI) (E-C/C-E)
5    	Long CI (E-C) (contemporary speeches I)
6	Long CI (C-E) (contemporary speeches II)
7	CI-- Multitasking- Shadowing-Smart shadowing
8   	Shadowing- Smart shadowing- SI (pre-exercises)
9    	Mid-term
10    	Booth etiquette/ Conference Interpretation as a profession
11    	Distancing exercises
12   	Simultaneous Interpretation (SI)
13   	SI (contemporary/authentic speeches on general topics w/o texts)
14   	SI (contemporary/authentic speeches on general topics w/o texts)
15   	SI (contemporary/authentic speeches on general topics w/o texts)
16   	Break
17   	SI (contemporary/authentic speeches on general topics w/o texts)
18   	Final
